text: Ugh... It's Friday night and I'm working late again. I've just gotta get the code for this bug fix submitted for review, then I can go home.
It just feels so unfair. Everyone else left hours ago, even my boss.
I also forgot to eat today...
Well, this should only take about an hour. Let's push on.
Man, these app breaking bugs keep popping up more and more. It's almost like we should take time to focus on tech debt instead of shoving in new features.
Heh, that'll never happen.
What the hell was that?
I guess it could just be the building settling... Weird.
I just wanna get this crap done and go home.
Boss: Hey Finley, just wanted to touch base. Where are we on that bug fix?
Haha! "We". As if she's here working on this crap with me.
You: Hey Karen. I should be finished up within the hour. Sorry for the delay!
Boss: Alright, just let me know when you're finished. It's critical that we get this fix in tonight.
You: Can do!

Synergy Metrics

Moving the needle daily.
What the...?! There's that strange sound again.
Maybe it's just one of my co-workers playing a prank on me. They know I'm working late again.
Very funny guys. Knock it off! I'm trying to do the work you all didn't wanna do.
Assholes.
Spouse: Hey! I thought you'd be home already. Where are you?
You: Sorry, I forgot to text you. I'm working late again. :/
Spouse: Again?! This is getting ridiculous. It's Friday night.
You: I know, but my boss is counting on me to get this bug fixed today. Should be home in a bit.
Spouse: You said that last time... Ugh. Fine. Just text me when you're leaving the office.
My partner is right. I have been working the graveyard shift a lot lately.
Wait. Is it really even the graveyard shift if I've been here since 9AM?
Oh boy... I just realized how tired I am. Not sure how long I can keep burning the midnight oil.
I'll just pour a quick cup of coffee.
Alright, back to working on this damn bug.
Boss: Just circling back since it's getting late. I have to go to bed soon. Have you submitted your code yet?
[color=red]Yes boss :)[/color]
